jobs.title: Product Manager II - Hardware
jobs.description:
About the role

Muon Space is hiring a Product Manager to own key spacecraft platform subsystems including power, GNC, and propulsion. Reporting to the Director of Product Management - Spacecraft, you will own the end-to-end roadmap that powers our spacecraft platform to meet customer mission needs.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office four days per week.

Responsibilities

- Spacecraft Subsystems

- Own the product roadmap for key spacecraft subsystems (Power, Propulsion, and GNC) which enable our spacecraft platforms.

- Define and prioritize features that improve product quality, schedule adherence, or customer value.

- Author clear Product Requirements Documents, drive alignment, and follow-through reliably.

- Partner with the Director of Product Management - Spacecraft to develop the strategy for the product area including make/buy decisions.

- Conduct customer interviews, gather feedback on product–market fit, and translate insights into roadmap decisions.

- Cross-functional Coordination

- Partner closely with engineering teams across hardware, mission systems, and mission architecture to define features and roadmap.

- Partner with production teams including AIT and supply chain to understand vendors, lead times, and opportunities.

- Coordinate with the Director of PM — Federal on defense-aligned product needs and inputs to roadmap.

- Collaborate with the VP of Product and the broader PM team on strategic roadmap decisions and prioritization trade-offs.

Required Qualifications

- 3–5 years of Product Management experience, with demonstrated success owning hardware products in technically complex environments.

- Experience in solar power systems, spacecraft propulsion, industrial robotics, or adjacent deep-tech hardware domains.

- Proven track record delivering major features or programs spanning multiple months of effort.

- History of independent execution and implementation across multiple concurrent workstreams.

- Strong fluency working with engineering peers and leadership; able to influence cross-organizational technical investment without direct authority.

- Demonstrated ability to translate customer mission needs into detailed product requirements and acceptance criteria across hardware subsystems.

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred.

Nice-to-have Skills

- Familiarity with solar power systems or Hall-effect thrusters.

- Familiarity with guidance, navigation, and control algorithms, simulations, and sensors.

- Familiarity with building or operating hardware for the space environment.

- Prior experience in startup or high-growth technology environments.

Salary

The salary range for this role is $190,000-$210,000,  plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

jobs.title: Product Manager II - Software & Communications
jobs.description:

Muon Space is hiring a Product Manager to own how much data our missions get to the ground, and how we prove it. Reporting to a Director of Product Management, you will own bits-to-ground communications across RF and optical links, simulation, and software test.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office four days per week.

Comms, Simulation and Test

- Own the product roadmap for bits-to-ground communications across RF and optical (OCT) links.

- Own the product roadmap for Muon Sim, the digital twin behind mission design and mission operations, including the throughput analysis that sets what a constellation can deliver.

- Grow simulation into a tool for software iteration, so flight and ground software can be exercised against the twin before it reaches a spacecraft.

- Own the product roadmap for software test infrastructure, automation, and hardware-in-the-loop environments.

- Define and prioritize features that improve product quality, schedule adherence, or customer value.

- Author clear Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), drive alignment, and follow through reliably.

Cross-functional Coordination

- Partner closely with engineering teams across ground software, simulation, test, and mission systems to define features and roadmap.

- Partner with other software product managers on roadmaps where capabilities intersect.

- Coordinate with the Director of PM — Federal on defense-aligned product needs and inputs to roadmap.

- Collaborate with the VP of Product and the broader PM team on strategic roadmap decisions and prioritization trade-offs.

- 3–5 years of Product Management experience, with demonstrated success owning software products in technically complex environments.

- Experience working cross-functionally with multiple engineering teams at once, rather than a single team.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

Muon Space is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of our internal Information Systems . You will be responsible for designing and managing various internal software and tools, integrating with industry-leading commercial solutions, and defining the entire Information Systems product lineup and roadmap.

Our proprietary systems and enterprise architecture are what enable us to manage our supply chain, manufacturing, financial operations, and mission execution. You will lead the charge on scaling critical business systems to keep pace with our rapidly expanding launch manifest.

The work requires a balance of strategic thinking and tactical execution—identifying where Muon Space can gain a strategic advantage through custom-built software and where we should seamlessly integrate with best-in-class third-party platforms. You will act as the bridge between technical software teams and business operations, putting your fingerprints on the operational foundation of the company.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

Responsibilities

- Product Strategy & Roadmap: Own the end-to-end product strategy, vision, and 12-18 month roadmap for Muon Space’s Information Systems and internal tools.

- Build vs. Buy: Drive critical "build vs. buy" decisions by synthesizing business needs, technical constraints, and user experience goals; balance the appropriate mix of industry-leading commercial software (e.g., ERP, PLM, MES) and custom-built internal solutions.

- Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders spanning Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, and Mission Operations to identify pain points, prioritize business needs, and deliver solutions with the highest ROI.

- Requirements & Execution: Translate complex operational requirements into clear product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria to guide internal software development and system integration.

- Cross-functional Coordination: Partner seamlessly with Information Systems software engineers, analysts, and IT teams to design, develop, and deploy meaningful, high-quality solutions, ensuring agile execution and timely delivery.

- Impact & Analytics: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to analyze the impact, user adoption, and operational efficiency of internal tools; continuously improve systems based on user feedback and data-driven insights.

- Integration & Architecture: Coordinate system integrations across platforms to ensure smooth data flows, regulatory compliance, and a unified enterprise architecture stack.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field; or equivalent practical experience.

- 7+ years of Product Management experience, with a proven track record of shipping internal tools, enterprise software, or business systems in a high-growth or technically complex environment.

- Previous experience operating within the aerospace, space, defense, or deep-tech hardware manufacturing industries.

- Demonstrated success leading "build vs. buy" evaluations, implementing commercial SaaS platforms, and integrating them with custom-built software via modern API frameworks.

- Strong technical fluency to engage with software engineers, database architects, and IT leadership as a peer.

- Proven ability to intake diverse stakeholder requirements, manage conflicting priorities without direct authority, and relentlessly prioritize roadmaps.

- Experience mapping out complex operational workflows and translating them into streamlined software experiences.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills

- Excited to work in a fast-paced environment with new challenges each week

Nice-to-have Skills

- Technical background with hands-on experience in software development, SQL, data modeling, or enterprise system architecture.

- Proven success in a high-growth startup environment

Salary

The salary range for this role is $272,000- $307,000 , plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Commercial Payloads
jobs.description:
About the role

Muon seeks a Senior Technical Program Manager - Commercial payloads to lead Muon Space’s Programs efforts, responsible for successfully delivering solutions, products, and technology while managing cost and schedule baselines contracts with the U.S. Government and Commercial Organizations. The Program Manager will be a key member of the Mission Engineering team and collaborate closely with Muon Space’s engineering, business, legal, finance, and operations departments. You will also support the portfolio's growth by fostering organic growth on existing contracts and supporting captures of new contracts.

As a Technical Program Manager at Muon Space, you delight our customers and users with high-quality products and solutions delivered on time and on budget, meeting our contractual obligations. You are cognizant of how all the pieces need to come together for successful program execution and can turn that into well-organized roadmaps, schedules, and budgets that you then track throughout the program lifecycle. You will be responsible for monitoring and ensuring successful execution of Muon’s contracts that you manage. You will support business development through proposals, RFI responses, customer engagement, and organic growth.

This role is based in San Jose with a hybrid schedule (3 days per week in-office).

Responsibilities

- Lead a multidisciplinary aerospace development effort, driving day-to-day execution of the program

- Engage with internal and external stakeholders to plan and coordinate the resources necessary to execute the program

- Synchronize a diverse technical team by establishing tools, practices, and process

- Participate in technical discussions, ask probing questions, and work with the team to pull together scoping, schedules, and solutions to issues

- Track and report program metrics on schedule, resource, cost, risk, and technical performance

- Serve as the face of the company to customers, subcontractors and suppliers

Qualifications

- 5+ years relevant experience in program management

- B.S. in an engineering discipline, M.S. or Ph.D. preferred

- Track record of successfully delivering complete systems (hardware, firmware, software, algorithms) on time, to scope, with high quality.

- Experience in development and/or program management of satellite based systems. Ability to instantiate and manage integrated master schedules.

- Expertise in modern, cloud-based productivity tools

- Excellent analytical and interpersonal skills, with ability to work successfully across all engineering disciplines.

- Experience in vendor and contract management

Nice-to-have Skills

- System engineering and experience with inter-discipline technical trade study

- Experience working with scripting languages (e.g. Python, Julia) and database queries (e..g SQL, BigQuery)  for data integration, analysis, and dashboarding.

- Experience in a fast-paced, startup environment

- Experience managing and growing teams

Salary

The salary range for this role is $206,000 - $232,000 plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Earth Observation
jobs.description:
About the role

Muon seeks a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead earth observation programs for U.S. Government customers. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of payload engineering and rapid-cycle space vehicle development. These programs span the full mission lifecycle — concept development and design through integration, launch, and on-orbit operations — and are executed under formal government contract structures with defined deliverables and milestones. The Senior TPM runs the program end to end: executing every contractual commitment and positioning Muon to win the work that follows.

The Senior TPM holds single-point accountability for delivering the program on schedule, within budget, and to technical performance standards. Operating with high autonomy on an accelerated contractual schedule, you will drive key milestones and lead cross-functional technical exchanges spanning systems engineering, payload, flight software, ground segment, and mission operations.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

Responsibilities

Program Execution

- Serve as the single accountable owner for the program's cost, schedule, and technical baselines

- Own the integrated master schedule, cost baseline, and risk register; track and report progress against contract milestones

- Plan and run formal program events — internal readiness reviews, and customer-facing milestone deliverable reviews

- Maintain tight cost and schedule discipline; surface deviations to the customer promptly and with a recovery plan

Customer Interface

- Act as the primary programmatic interface to the Government customer, including contracting and technical representatives

- Lead technical exchange meetings and convert customer input into actionable program direction

- Own the delivery and quality of all contract data deliverables

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Direct a cross-functional team spanning systems engineering, payload, flight software, ground processing, and mission operations

- Partner with mission operations when program activities involve Muon's operational systems — without disrupting existing missions

- Drive design trades and study conclusions to closure on schedule, escalating crisply when decisions stall

Security, Compliance, and Growth

- Execute the program in full compliance with its government security requirements, including handling of controlled information and strict public-release restrictions

- Ensure compliance with ITAR/EAR export controls and U.S.-only performance requirements

- Support program growth: convert program artifacts into proposal-ready material and support capture of follow-on opportunities

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering or a technical field, or equivalent experience.

- 8+ years of program management experience on complex aerospace or defense development programs, including direct ownership of cost, schedule, and technical baselines

- Experience executing U.S. Government contracts: statement-of-work and CDRL deliverables, milestone-based structures, and day-to-day work with government contracting and technical representatives

- Experience leading engineering teams through concept development, trade studies, and preliminary design

- Exceptional written communication skills — you will author and own the quality of customer-facing reports, design artifacts, and contract deliverables

Preferred Qualifications

- Satellite or instrument program leadership across the full lifecycle (design, build,

- integrate, test, operate)

- Domain experience with remote sensing systems — EO/IR, RF, or both — at the payload or mission level

- Direct experience working with USSF Space Systems Command or JPL

- PMP certification or equivalent program management credentials

- Ability to obtain a security clearance

Salary

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive cross-functional planning and execution for our Software programs. In this role, you will work closely with engineering leaders across software, hardware, science, and product to coordinate efforts from early concept through delivery to (literal!) launch. You will develop schedules and milestones, uncover gaps, flag risks, support resource planning, and ensure clear communication across stakeholders.

As a Software TPM, you’ll help teams stay aligned, unblock issues quickly, and deliver critical software capabilities that power Muon’s mission. You will provide the structure and process discipline required to scale our development efforts, while enabling teams to make fast, high-quality decisions in a complex, interdisciplinary environment.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

Responsibilities

- Program Planning & Roadmapping: Define objectives, scope, milestones, and success criteria in collaboration with engineering and product stakeholders.

- Scheduling & Execution Management: Build and maintain project timelines, track dependencies, monitor progress, and adjust plans as priorities shift.

- Risk & Issue Management: Identify risks early, coordinate mitigation plans, surface blockers, and drive timely resolution.

- Cross-Functional Coordination: Facilitate collaboration across software, hardware, science, and product teams, ensuring aligned deliverables and clear handoffs.

- Communication & Reporting: Provide concise, actionable updates to stakeholders and leadership on progress, changes, risks, and decisions.

- Process & Continuous Improvement: Identify inefficiencies in workflows, propose improvements, and help implement better practices and tools.

- Resource & Capacity Planning: Assist in forecasting resource needs, tracking capacity, and supporting prioritization and staffing decisions.

- Release Planning & Readiness: Coordinate software releases, track readiness criteria, and communicate expectations to impacted teams.

Qualifications

- BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 3-5+ years of experience as a software engineer or in a similar technical role.

- 3-5+ years of experience managing or coordinating software development projects.

- Demonstrated ability to establish and optimize software project management processes.

- Strong technical background with knowledge of software development methods, tools, and infrastructure.

- Proven ability to communicate effectively with diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Experience leading cross-functional planning, scheduling, and risk management across multiple teams.

- Results-oriented mindset with a bias toward clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

- Excited to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with evolving priorities.

Nice to have

- Experience in aerospace, robotics, logistics, or other domains with real-time high-reliability software development requirements.

- Experience reviewing technical documentation, architecture proposals, or requirements specifications.

- Comfort with Jira, Confluence and other productivity tools

- Exposure to OKR or goal-setting frameworks, and alignment of program priorities with company objectives.

- Ability to work effectively in distributed team environments.

Salary

The salary range for this role is $ 206,000 - $232,000 , plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.
About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

Taking Care of Our Team

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too.  Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Muon is currently registered and able to hire in the following states:
AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IA, ID, MD, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX, VT, VA, WA

ITAR/EAR Requirements

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. The Company may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Avionics
jobs.description:
About the role

Muon seeks an Avionics Technical Program Manager to lead the end-to-end planning, production, acceptance testing, and delivery of flight electronic assemblies for our next-generation satellite constellations. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of electrical engineering, hardware manufacturing, flight software, and Assembly, Integration, and Test (AI&T).

The Avionics TPM will serve as the primary operational owner for transforming engineered printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) into complete, tested units ready for spacecraft integration and software development testbeds. The role spans hardware development, supply chain coordination, unit testing execution, and fleet-scale delivery across multiple concurrent missions.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

Please note: This role will need full time on-site (5x/week) for the first six months for a ramp up period and then can transition to hybrid schedule (3x/week)

Responsibilities

- Hardware Delivery

- Avionics Unit Delivery: Own the complete delivery pipeline and schedule for fully tested, flight-ready PCBA units to AI&T for spacecraft vehicle integration.

- Testbed Fleet Support: Deliver complete, validated PCBA units to Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL) testbeds to support ongoing Flight Software (FSW) development, verification, and mission simulations.

- Unit Acceptance Testing (UAT) & Qualification

- UAT Execution: Drive the planning, resource allocation, and schedule execution of Unit Acceptance Testing (UAT) for all flight avionics entering AI&T.

- Program Metrics & Reporting: Track, analyze, and report UAT performance metrics—including schedule variance, test bed readiness, yield rates, technical performance, and risk posture.

- Cross-Functional Execution & Release Planning

- Release Timeline Planning: Partner with engineering teams to establish, maintain, and execute PCBA release timelines across current and future satellite constellation blocks.

- Cross-Functional Coordination: Drive end-to-end execution across cross-functional teams spanning EE design, PCBA fabrication, assembly, functional testing, and vehicle AI&T.

- Supply Chain & Risk Management

- Procurement Tracking: Track procurement, long-lead component acquisition, and assembly status for all custom PCBAs and associated mechanical enclosures/mounting hardware.

- Issue Resolution: Proactively identify, track, and drive resolution of supply chain bottlenecks, component obsolescence, component lead time spikes, and test fallout issues.

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, or hardware production management delivering complex electronic assemblies, electronics systems, or aerospace hardware.

- Hands-on technical background in electrical engineering, computer engineering, embedded systems, or avionics testing.

- Proven track record managing PCBA production lifecycles—from design releases and fab/assembly procurement through functional board bring-up and acceptance testing.

- Demonstrated experience managing programs with a complex critical-path supply chain

- Familiarity with hardware/software integration environments, testbeds, or Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL) simulators used for flight software development.

- Familiarity with program management scheduling tools such as Smartsheets, Microsoft Project, or similar software.

- U.S. Citizenship required (program is ITAR-restricted).

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience in satellite or aerospace AI&T, avionics manufacturing, or satellite constellation volume production.

- Working knowledge of space-grade PCBA standards (e.g., IPC-J-STD-001GS/Space Addendum, IPC-A-610, NASA-STD-8739).

- Experience managing environmental/acceptance testing campaigns for electronics (e.g., thermal cycling, functional screening, vibe/shock testing).

- Proficiency with ERP/PLM and tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Arena, Agile PLM, SAP, or similar toolsets).

- PMP certification or equivalent program management credentials.

- Experience operating the Linux command line interface and writing scripts with the Python programming language.

Salary

The salary range for this role is $174,000 - $199,000 , plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.
